sources.title: NousCoder-14B: A Competitive Olympiad Programming Model - NOUS RESEARCH
sources.snippet: Nous Research introduces NousCoder-14B, a competitive olympiad programming model post-trained on Qwen3-14B via reinforcement learning.The full stack is released publicly: model weights, open RL environment + eval harness, and @wandb logs; we also document the pipelined verification setup and parallelization experiments so others can reproduce the training stack.

sources.title: NousCoder‑14B: Open-Source AI Coding Model Rivaling Claude Code
sources.snippet: What is NousCoder‑14B? NousCoder‑14B is a 14-billion parameter AI coding model developed by Nous Research, designed to handle everything from coding challenges to real-world programming tasks. Unlike many closed-source AI models, it is fully open-source, allowing developers to inspect, modify, and run it locally without restrictions.
